[D1] (15:3-15:15) TS377018: This expression discards the success value through mapping. `Effect.asVoid` represents that form directly. effect(effectMapVoid)
  Fix 0: "Disable effectMapVoid for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable effectMapVoid for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.asVoid"

[D2] (21:3-21:8) TS377018: This expression discards the success value through mapping. `Effect.asVoid` represents that form directly. effect(effectMapVoid)
  Fix 0: "Disable effectMapVoid for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable effectMapVoid for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.asVoid"

[D3] (26:3-26:19) TS377144: `Effect.tap` expresses this observation more directly than `Effect.flatMap` with a manual re-yield. effect(flatMapToTap)
  Fix 0: "Disable flatMapToTap for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable flatMapToTap for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.tap"

[D4] (32:3-32:20) TS377153: `Effect.map` + `Effect.mapError` transform the success and failure channels one step at a time; `Effect.mapBoth` expresses both transformations in a single step. effect(mapMapErrorToMapBoth)
  Fix 0: "Disable mapMapErrorToMapBoth for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable mapMapErrorToMapBoth for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.mapBoth"

[D5] (37:3-37:15) TS377154: `Effect.trackSuccesses` expresses recording a metric on every success directly. effect(manualMetricTapToTrack)
  Fix 0: "Disable manualMetricTapToTrack for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable manualMetricTapToTrack for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.trackSuccesses"

[D6] (41:23-44:3) TS377036: This `Schema.Struct` includes a `_tag` field. `Schema.TaggedStruct` is the tagged-struct form for this pattern and makes the tag optional in the constructor. effect(schemaStructWithTag)
  Fix 0: "Disable schemaStructWithTag for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable schemaStructWithTag for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Rewrite as Schema.TaggedStruct"

--- file:///.src/moduleReference_barrelNamespace.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectMapVoid:warning
// @effect-diagnostics flatMapToTap:warning
// @effect-diagnostics mapMapErrorToMapBoth:warning
// @effect-diagnostics manualMetricTapToTrack:warning
// @effect-diagnostics schemaStructWithTag:warning
import * as X from "effect"

declare const source: X.Effect.Effect<number, string>
declare const audit: (n: number) => X.Effect.Effect<string>
const requests = X.Metric.counter("requests")

// Fixes reference the modules through the barrel namespace import: X.Effect.asVoid
export const mapVoid = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.asVoid
)

// The receiver is a local alias of the module; the fix still uses the import
const E = X.Effect
export const aliasedMapVoid = source.pipe(
  E.map(() => undefined)
)

// X.Effect.tap is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const flatMapToTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.flatMap((n) => audit(n).pipe(X.Effect.as(n)))
)

// X.Effect.mapBoth is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const mapMapError = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map((n) => n > 0),
  X.Effect.mapError((message) => new Error(message))
)

// X.Effect.trackSuccesses and X.Metric.withConstantInput are resolved through the barrel namespace
export const metricTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.tap(X.Metric.update(requests, 1))
)

// X.Schema.TaggedStruct
export const Tagged = X.Schema.Struct({
  _tag: X.Schema.Literal("Tagged"),
  value: X.Schema.Number
})

// @effect-diagnostics *:off

// @effect-diagnostics flatMapToTap:warning
// @effect-diagnostics mapMapErrorToMapBoth:warning
// @effect-diagnostics manualMetricTapToTrack:warning
// @effect-diagnostics schemaStructWithTag:warning

const requests = X.Metric.counter("requests")

// Fixes reference the modules through the barrel namespace import: X.Effect.asVoid

  X.Effect.map(() => undefined)
)

// The receiver is a local alias of the module; the fix still uses the import
const E = X.Effect
export const aliasedMapVoid = source.pipe(
  E.map(() => undefined)
)

// X.Effect.tap is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const flatMapToTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.tap((n) => audit(n))
)

// X.Effect.mapBoth is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const mapMapError = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map((n) => n > 0),

--- file:///.src/moduleReference_barrelNamespace.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectMapVoid:warning
// @effect-diagnostics flatMapToTap:warning
// @effect-diagnostics mapMapErrorToMapBoth:warning
// @effect-diagnostics manualMetricTapToTrack:warning
// @effect-diagnostics schemaStructWithTag:warning
import * as X from "effect"

declare const source: X.Effect.Effect<number, string>
declare const audit: (n: number) => X.Effect.Effect<string>
const requests = X.Metric.counter("requests")

// Fixes reference the modules through the barrel namespace import: X.Effect.asVoid
export const mapVoid = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map(() => undefined)
)

// The receiver is a local alias of the module; the fix still uses the import
const E = X.Effect
export const aliasedMapVoid = source.pipe(
  E.map(() => undefined)
)

// X.Effect.tap is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const flatMapToTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.flatMap((n) => audit(n).pipe(X.Effect.as(n)))
)

// X.Effect.mapBoth is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const mapMapError = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.mapBoth({
    onSuccess: n => n > 0,
    onFailure: message => new Error(message)
})
)

// X.Effect.trackSuccesses and X.Metric.withConstantInput are resolved through the barrel namespace
export const metricTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.tap(X.Metric.update(requests, 1))
)

// X.Schema.TaggedStruct
export const Tagged = X.Schema.Struct({
  _tag: X.Schema.Literal("Tagged"),
  value: X.Schema.Number
})

// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectMapVoid:warning
// @effect-diagnostics flatMapToTap:warning
// @effect-diagnostics mapMapErrorToMapBoth:warning
// @effect-diagnostics manualMetricTapToTrack:warning
// @effect-diagnostics schemaStructWithTag:warning
import * as X from "effect"

declare const source: X.Effect.Effect<number, string>
declare const audit: (n: number) => X.Effect.Effect<string>
const requests = X.Metric.counter("requests")

// Fixes reference the modules through the barrel namespace import: X.Effect.asVoid
export const mapVoid = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map(() => undefined)
)

// The receiver is a local alias of the module; the fix still uses the import
const E = X.Effect
export const aliasedMapVoid = source.pipe(
  E.map(() => undefined)
)

// X.Effect.tap is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const flatMapToTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.flatMap((n) => audit(n).pipe(X.Effect.as(n)))
)

// X.Effect.mapBoth is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const mapMapError = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map((n) => n > 0),
  X.Effect.mapError((message) => new Error(message))
)

// X.Effect.trackSuccesses and X.Metric.withConstantInput are resolved through the barrel namespace
export const metricTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.trackSuccesses(X.Metric.withConstantInput(requests, 1))
)

// X.Schema.TaggedStruct
export const Tagged = X.Schema.Struct({
  _tag: X.Schema.Literal("Tagged"),
  value: X.Schema.Number
})

// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectMapVoid:warning
// @effect-diagnostics flatMapToTap:warning
// @effect-diagnostics mapMapErrorToMapBoth:warning
// @effect-diagnostics manualMetricTapToTrack:warning
// @effect-diagnostics schemaStructWithTag:warning
import * as X from "effect"

declare const source: X.Effect.Effect<number, string>
declare const audit: (n: number) => X.Effect.Effect<string>
const requests = X.Metric.counter("requests")

// Fixes reference the modules through the barrel namespace import: X.Effect.asVoid
export const mapVoid = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map(() => undefined)
)

// The receiver is a local alias of the module; the fix still uses the import
const E = X.Effect
export const aliasedMapVoid = source.pipe(
  E.map(() => undefined)
)

// X.Effect.tap is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const flatMapToTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.flatMap((n) => audit(n).pipe(X.Effect.as(n)))
)

// X.Effect.mapBoth is resolved through the barrel namespace
export const mapMapError = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.map((n) => n > 0),
  X.Effect.mapError((message) => new Error(message))
)

// X.Effect.trackSuccesses and X.Metric.withConstantInput are resolved through the barrel namespace
export const metricTap = source.pipe(
  X.Effect.tap(X.Metric.update(requests, 1))
)

// X.Schema.TaggedStruct
export const Tagged = X.Schema.TaggedStruct("Tagged", { value: X.Schema.Number })
